@FusionLogInterpretation.initial_placement_interprets : ∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] {α : Type u_1}
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] (P : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Placement n (Finset α))
  (nonempty : (FusionLogReplay.occupiedSites P).Nonempty),
  P =
    FusionLogInterpretation.expandPlacement (FusionLogInterpretation.siteLabels P)
      (FusionLogInterpretation.canonicalPlacement P nonempty)
@FusionLogInterpretation.batchPlan_interprets : ∀ {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [DecidableEq ι]
  [inst : DecidableEq α] (labels : ι → Finset α) (G : Finset ι) (F : Finset α)
  (source : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Execution n ι) (target : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Placement n (Finset ι))
  (plan : FusionLogCompression.BatchPlacementPlan G source target) (actual : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Execution n α),
  actual.placed = FusionLogInterpretation.expandPlacement labels source.placed →
    ∃ actualPlan,
      actualPlan.word = plan.word ∧ actualPlan.batches = plan.batches ∧ actualPlan.transfers = plan.transfers
@FusionLogInterpretation.arbitrary_initial_log_endpoint_budget : ∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] {α : Type u_1}
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] (F : Finset α) (actual : FusionLogCompression.LoggedExecution n α)
  (word : List RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter),
  3 ≤ n →
    ∀ (nonempty : (FusionLogReplay.occupiedSites actual.state.placed).Nonempty),
      ∃ plan,
        (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F actual plan.word).fullLog =
            (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F actual word).fullLog ∧
          (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F actual plan.word).state.placed =
              (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F actual word).state.placed ∧
            plan.word.length ≤
                FusionLogReplay.normalFormBudget n (FusionLogReplay.occupiedSites actual.state.placed).card
                  (FusionLogReplay.occupiedSites (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F actual.state word).placed).card ∧
              plan.batches ≤ (FusionLogReplay.occupiedSites actual.state.placed).card - 1 ∧
                plan.transfers ≤
                  FusionLogReplay.normalFormTransferBudget n (FusionLogReplay.occupiedSites actual.state.placed).card
                    (FusionLogReplay.occupiedSites (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F actual.state word).placed).card
@FusionLogInterpretation.arbitrary_initial_log_endpoint_representative : ∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] {α : Type u_1}
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] (F : Finset α) (actual : FusionLogCompression.LoggedExecution n α)
  (word : List RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter),
  3 ≤ n →
    (FusionLogReplay.occupiedSites actual.state.placed).Nonempty →
      ∃ representative,
        (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F actual representative).fullLog =
            (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F actual word).fullLog ∧
          (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F actual representative).state.placed =
              (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F actual word).state.placed ∧
            representative.length ≤
              FusionLogReplay.normalFormBudget n (FusionLogReplay.occupiedSites actual.state.placed).card
                (FusionLogReplay.occupiedSites (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F actual.state word).placed).card
@FusionLogInterpretation.named_initial_log_endpoint_representative : ∀ {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] {α : Type u_1}
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] {r : ℕ} [inst_2 : NeZero r] (F : Finset α)
  (actual : FusionLogCompression.LoggedExecution n α) (word : List RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Letter),
  3 ≤ n →
    ∀ (named : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.LegalNamedPlacement n r α),
      actual.state.placed = named.placed →
        ∃ representative,
          (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F actual representative).fullLog =
              (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F actual word).fullLog ∧
            (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F actual representative).state.placed =
                (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F actual word).state.placed ∧
              representative.length ≤
                FusionLogReplay.normalFormBudget n r
                  (FusionLogReplay.occupiedSites (RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F actual.state word).placed).card
